# UKEN

> UKEN is a direct-trade marketplace connecting UK buyers with East African farmers, artisans, and makers — across Kenya, Uganda, Tanzania, Rwanda and the wider EAC. Every product is traceable from maker to door.

UKEN sells specialty East African coffee, tea, foods, textiles, beadwork, pottery, and craft. The platform pairs each product with the person who made it — their country, region, craft, and story — and ships directly from East Africa to the UK. Kenya is the flagship origin; Uganda, Tanzania, Rwanda, Burundi, South Sudan and DR Congo are featured partner countries.
